## Houston 1.0.6

### What's new

- **Mistral Large 4 is now the default Mistral model.**
- **Routine history tells you when a routine can't run as its owner.** If the person a routine runs as can no longer use the AI Employee, the failed run says so and tells you the fix: pause the routine and resume it.
- **Only a routine's creator can create or replace its webhook key.** Everyone else still sees whether the routine has a webhook, along with who can change it.

### Fixes and polish

- Pressing Stop no longer leaves an AI Employee stuck as busy.
- Skills shared with your team now load in every chat with an AI Employee running in the cloud.
- If your team's allowed models name an older Claude model, members can pick Claude again instead of being sent to OpenRouter.
- Reloading the page while Houston saves your first conversation no longer leaves your AI Manager's chat empty.
- A routine always runs as the person who last saved it.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
